title: Temperature: Reading Thermometers in Degrees Celsius
seo_title: Grade 4 Temperature Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Measure temperature in degrees Celsius using thermometers; read and record temperature; calculate temperature differences limited to positive whole numbers.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 4 temperature worksheets: reading thermometers in degrees Celsius, likely temperatures, differences and temperature tables. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Water freezes at 0 °C and boils at 100 °C.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • We measure temperature in degrees Celsius (°C) with a thermometer.
  • Water freezes at 0 °C and boils at 100 °C. Our body temperature is about 37 °C.
  • Read the thermometer at the top of the liquid. Check what each small mark stands for.
  • The difference between two temperatures: subtract the lower from the higher.

Examples

Example

Durban 29 °C, Johannesburg 21 °C

29 − 21

Answer: 8 °C warmer in Durban

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The next markCount the marks carefully from a number.
Adding for a differenceSubtract to find the difference.
Impossible valuesThink: hot tea is not 7 °C.

faq.a: Read and record temperature in degrees Celsius using thermometers, and calculate temperature differences limited to positive whole numbers.

faq.q: Why does CAPS use only positive numbers?
faq.a: Negative numbers come in later grades.
